::: {#perfil}

He holds a Ph.D. and an M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering from PUC-Rio and a B.Sc. in Telecommunications and Electronic Engineering from 
the Universidad de Oriente (Santiago de Cuba). His research focuses on computer vision, machine learning, deep learning, remote sensing, 
and biometrics. He is a member of the International Society of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (ISPRS) and the Brazilian Chapter of the 
IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Society (GRSS). He is a researcher at the L@BISEN laboratory at ISEN Yncréa Ouest.

## Education

- PhD in Electrical Engineering, PUC-Rio.
- MSc in Signal Processing, PUC-Rio.
- BSc in Telecommunications and Electronics Engineering, Universidad de Oriente (Santiago de Cuba).

## Interests

Computer vision, machine learning, deep learning, remote sensing, and biometrics.
